title: Code for: Observation-conditioned bounds enable experimental decisions despite mechanistic equivalence in bacterial nitrogen signaling
description: Reproducible code, published-data records, figures and manuscript sources for Observation-conditioned bounds enable experimental decisions despite mechanistic equivalence in bacterial nitrogen signaling. Version 1.3.4 aligns the title, abstract, Author Summary, cover letter and the messages of Figures 3--4 around the observation-conditioned concentration certificate and end-to-end binding benchmark. It retains the v1.3.2 scientific corrections and v1.3.1 verification fixes. The fitted predictions and figures are unchanged. No new experimental measurements were generated. Native-assay applications remain conditional on the stated observation, biochemical and calibration assumptions. Original code is MIT licensed; the retained Gosztolai et al. workbook and model retain their CC BY 4.0 attribution. Primary literature PDFs are not redistributed.
